_source: Anglo American Interim Results 2023 + 2024 presentations (cat3-european annual-text). Note : sources sont des présentations H1 et appels d'analystes, pas le 20-F complet. Historique limité à 2-3 ans.

kpis.description_fr: EBITDA H1 Anglo American. Marge H1 2024 = 33% (vs 31% H1 2023). Cuivre + minerai fer = 70% de la contribution.
kpis.description_en: Anglo American H1 EBITDA. H1 2024 margin = 33% (vs 31% H1 2023). Copper + iron ore = 70% contribution.

kpis.description_fr: EBITDA H1 segment Iron Ore (Minas-Rio + Kumba). Premium iron ore franchise.
kpis.description_en: H1 Iron Ore segment EBITDA (Minas-Rio + Kumba). Premium iron ore franchise.

kpis.description_fr: EBITDA H1 Copper & Nickel (Los Bronces, Quellaveco, Collahuasi). Marge supérieure 43-53% selon mine.
kpis.description_en: H1 Copper & Nickel EBITDA (Los Bronces, Quellaveco, Collahuasi). 43-53% margin per mine.

kpis.description_fr: EBITDA H1 segment PGMs (Mogalakwena, Amandelbult). Mogalakwena revised mine plan en cours.
kpis.description_en: H1 PGMs segment EBITDA (Mogalakwena, Amandelbult). Mogalakwena revised mine plan underway.

kpis.description_fr: Ratio dette nette sur EBITDA annualisé. Cible bottom-of-cycle <1.5x. Solide bilan post-Botswana renewal.
kpis.description_en: Net debt to annualized EBITDA ratio. Bottom-of-cycle target <1.5x. Solid balance sheet post-Botswana renewal.

kpis.description_fr: Marge EBITDA H1. Discipline coûts, mix copper/iron ore favorable malgré chute prix matériaux.
kpis.description_en: H1 EBITDA margin. Cost discipline, favorable copper/iron ore mix despite commodity price drop.

kpis.signal: Pilier stratégique #1, target 1Mt+ via Quellaveco + Sakatti, electrification beneficiary
kpis.description_fr: Production cuivre kt FY. Pilier stratégique #1 post-restructuration 2024 (focus cuivre/iron ore). Croissance Quellaveco (Pérou). Cible >1Mtpa moyen terme.
kpis.description_en: Copper production kt FY. #1 strategic pillar post-2024 restructuring (copper/iron ore focus). Quellaveco (Peru) ramp-up. >1Mtpa target medium-term.

kpis.signal: Pilier #2 conservé restructuration, Kumba (Afrique du Sud) + Minas-Rio (Brésil), volumes stables
kpis.description_fr: Production iron ore Mt FY. Kumba (Afrique du Sud) + Minas-Rio (Brésil). Conservé dans recentrage 2024. Volumes stables, sensible prix global.
kpis.description_en: Iron ore production Mt FY. Kumba (South Africa) + Minas-Rio (Brazil). Retained in 2024 restructuring. Stable volumes, sensitive to global prices.

kpis.signal: Marché diamants en crise (lab-grown + ralentissement Chine), divesti annoncé 2024
kpis.description_fr: Ventes diamants bruts De Beers (85% Anglo). Crise marché (lab-grown diamonds + ralentissement Chine + Inde). Désinvestissement annoncé mai 2024 dans plan restructuration.
kpis.description_en: De Beers (85% Anglo) rough diamond sales. Market crisis (lab-grown diamonds + China/India slowdown). Divestiture announced May 2024 in restructuring plan.

kpis.signal: Pic FY21 ($20.6 Mds), normalisation cyclique post-pic commodities, FY24 -15% sur baisse PGMs + iron ore prix
kpis.description_fr: EBITDA sous-jacent. Pic 2021 $20.6 Mds sur boom commodities post-COVID. Normalisation cyclique. Pression FY24 sur PGMs + iron ore price.
kpis.description_en: Underlying EBITDA. FY21 peak $20.6B on post-COVID commodity boom. Cyclical normalization. FY24 pressure on PGMs + iron ore prices.

kpis.signal: Incident Grosvenor fire 2024 + désinvestissement annoncé (vente Peabody Energy 2024)
kpis.description_fr: Production charbon métallurgique Mt (Queensland Australia : Moranbah North, Grosvenor, Aquila). Incident fire Grosvenor juin 2024. Vente annoncée à Peabody Energy nov 2024.
kpis.description_en: Steelmaking coal production Mt (Queensland Australia: Moranbah North, Grosvenor, Aquila). Grosvenor fire incident June 2024. Sale to Peabody Energy announced Nov 2024.

_note: Données H1 (semestrielles). Full year data non disponible dans les sources scrapées. Re-scrape annual 20-F via Companies House UK ou Anglo American IR pour FY data.
